heading: Definitions
lead: As used in this chapter, the following definitions shall apply:

tree.heading: Court order
tree.text: The term “court order” includes a court order (as described in section 922(g)(8) of title 18).

tree.heading: Mental health terms
tree.text: The terms “adjudicated as a mental defective” and “committed to a mental institution” have the same meanings as in section 922(g)(4) of title 18.

tree.heading: Misdemeanor crime of domestic violence
tree.text: The term “misdemeanor crime of domestic violence” has the meaning given the term in section 921(a)(33) of title 18.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified in a note under section 922 of Title 18, Crimes and Criminal Procedure, prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.
